prompts.name: hero-scene
prompts.reference_note: Historical generation input; autumn-v1 was removed after the v2 refresh. Recover the original from this Git commit if needed.
prompts.input_role: character identity, seasonal outfit and atmosphere reference
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: regenerated autumn website hero, one widescreen 16:9 full-bleed anime illustration.
Input image 1: existing site artwork, reference for character identity, seasonal outfit, red parasol, and autumn lakeside atmosphere only. Create a fresh improved illustration, not a duplicate.
Primary request: Tsukimi Yachiyo sitting comfortably on a dry wooden lakeside veranda beneath a red paper parasol on a serene autumn moonlit evening. Preserve recognizable silver-white very long hair with pink undersides, two distinctive looped hair buns, gold hairpins, rose-red eyes, gentle welcoming smile, crimson and dark navy maple-pattern kimono with gold obi. Natural relaxed seated pose and anatomically correct hands; clothing elegantly draped.
Scene: Japanese lakeside houses with small warm amber paper lanterns, subtle reflections, distant misty mountains, a pale golden full moon, red and burnt-orange maple branches framing upper corners.
Composition: character face around 72 percent of image width, complete head and both hair loops comfortably inside frame with top margin; right half carries the character and parasol, left half calm open lake suitable for the existing website copy veil. Render a real scenic left half, not an empty panel. Strong readable character silhouette, visually clear at thumbnail and mobile crops.
Style: refined high-quality Japanese anime background and character illustration, fine controlled linework, layered soft atmospheric depth, restrained highlights, natural fabric folds. Cooler quiet navy lake balances warm maple and lantern accents; avoid the original's excessive orange glare, clutter, and sparkling particles.
Constraints: one character only, no text, no writing on lanterns, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no cards or borders; fully opaque. Landscape 16:9.

prompts.name: background-light
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: autumn website light-appearance full-page background, one widescreen 16:9 environmental illustration.
Input image 1 is the newly selected autumn hero, reference for location, fine anime rendering, maple foliage and warm lanterns; no character or parasol may appear in this landscape.
Primary request: a fresh tranquil empty Japanese lakeside panorama in luminous autumn blue hour, pale golden full moon high above layered misty mountains. Delicate red, copper and orange maple boughs frame the upper corners and edges; a few traditional wooden lakeside houses and small amber lanterns sit along the outer shores. Soft pearl-lavender sky, pale blue water with subtle amber reflections, bright gentle mist. Keep the broad central lake and sky low-contrast and open for the light website's content overlays, while retaining real scenic detail. Fine atmospheric depth, controlled highlights, graceful asymmetric natural composition. A narrow wooden lakeside walkway visible at lower edge, a few fallen maple leaves.
Constraints: landscape 16:9, no people, no character silhouette, no red parasol, no huge foreground prop; fully opaque; no lettering, writing on lanterns, logo, watermark, UI, panels, borders or collage. No fiery orange sky or dazzling water glare.
prompts.input_role: location and style reference; exclude character

prompts.name: article-cover
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: autumn website article default cover and navigation thumbnail, one landscape 16:9 full-bleed anime illustration.
Input image 1 is the newly selected autumn hero, exact character identity, seasonal outfit, illustration style and location reference.
Primary request: a complementary close waist-up three-quarter portrait of the SAME Tsukimi Yachiyo on the lakeside wooden veranda beneath delicate red and copper maple branches. Preserve silver-white long hair with pink undersides, two looped hair buns, gold pins, rose-red eyes, gentle welcoming smile, crimson and deep navy maple kimono with gold obi. She holds one small ceramic autumn tea cup naturally with both hands at chest level. The red paper parasol rests behind her. Fine anime linework, soft warm amber lantern light on her face, quiet navy-blue lake and distant wooden houses, pale gold moon.

Constraints: same recognizable face and outfit, one character only, landscape 16:9, opaque; no text, writing on objects, logo, watermark, UI, border, collage, graphic panel, extra fingers, or harsh bloom.
prompts.input_role: character identity, outfit, style and location reference

prompts.name: background-dark
prompts.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: matching autumn dark-appearance website background, one widescreen 16:9 image.
Input image 1 is the EXACT edit target, the approved light autumn lakeside landscape.
Primary request: change only lighting, sky brightness and tonal treatment to serene deep moonlit night. Preserve the exact camera, image framing, positions and shapes of every maple bough, moon, mountain, house, lantern, railing, deck, and leaf. Deep midnight indigo and charcoal-blue sky and lake, subtle moonlit mist, subdued crimson and copper foliage, small controlled amber windows and lantern glow. Make broad lake and sky substantially darker and low contrast for a dark website overlay, while retaining detail in the shadows. Pale gold moon, restrained reflections, no excessive bloom.
Constraints: no geometric changes, no added objects, no people, no red parasol, no text, logo, watermark, UI or borders; fully opaque; keep original 16:9 aspect ratio.
prompts.input_role: exact edit target; lighting change only

prompts.name: pixel-workshop
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: autumn website pixel-workshop cover, one widescreen 16:9 full-bleed PIXEL ART landscape.
Input image 1 is reference ONLY for the autumn lakeside setting, maple foliage, houses, moon and palette; completely reinterpret it with deliberately visible crisp square pixel clusters and staircase edges.
Primary request: a cozy small traditional wooden tea house on the right beside a tranquil moonlit lake, short lakeside wooden walkway and railings, warm amber lit windows and a paper lantern, copper and crimson maple trees framing both edges, a few fallen leaves, layered blue distant mountains and pale gold full moon reflected on water. Strong readable small-thumbnail composition, navy water and sky balancing autumn leaves. Handcrafted 2D game-background pixel art with coherent limited palette, economical shapes, carefully placed pixel highlights, hard pixel edges and very light pixel dithering. No blurry painterly shading. No people, no character or parasol.
Constraints: one opaque landscape, 16:9, no text, logo, watermark, UI, editor interface, border, collage, checkerboard or pixel grid lines.
prompts.input_role: setting and palette reference for pixel art
